thread:
ana: ran a quick sweep bringing up the q4_0 quantized variant of the new-v2 model across H100/A100 in us-east/us-west/eu-west. p50 looks fine everywhere but p95 in eu-west jumps when requests hit regional proxy. paste of raw p50/p95 below.

ana: ```
config, gpu, region, p50_ms, p95_ms, qps
q4_0, H100, us-east, 36, 84, 145
q4_0, H100, us-west, 38, 92, 138
q4_0, H100, eu-west, 45, 210, 120
q4_0, A100, us-east, 48, 130, 110
q4_0, A100, eu-west, 60, 290, 95
```

dmitri: that eu p95 is wild. did we use the same kernel profile across regions?

ana: yes same build; runtime selected fast-attn-v2 kernels on H100, falls back to baseline on A100. the eu-west nodes routed through edge-proxy-03 for a subset of clients which adds an extra hop and occasional TLS renegotiation.

eva: do we have tcp-level metrics? packet retransmits or SYN retries around the p95 windows?

ana: brief tcp dump shows small bursts at ~10:12:xx UTC concurrent with the p95 spikes. looks like connection churn from the proxy pool.

frank: can we repro by forcing a regional-egress change? maybe route eu traffic to us-east just for the canary and compare?

ana: did that for a 30m test: eu -> pinned-us-east results improved p95 to ~95ms (H100). throughput steady. so routing is the main delta, not quantization.

dmitri: good. next steps: 1) try disabling proxy pool handoff for eu canary, 2) test with small batching (batch=2) to see latency tail effects, 3) validate A100 kernel tuning.

eva: also try bumping keepalive to avoid renegotiation and check TLS session reuse. small change but low friction.

frank: I'll open a short canary plan. if eu requires pinning for now, capacity sizing needs to account for cross-pop egress cost and extra tokens. add notes to the capacity doc.

ana: adding quick kernel note: fast-attn-v2 on H100 yields ~15% p50 improvement vs baseline, but regression on p95 when network hop added. for A100 we should try the matmul-tiling optimized kernels (label: tiling-opt-1) to reduce p95 by ~10%.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: canary-id=ci-3921, scope=eu-west pin->us-east, start_ts=1955556670

dmitri: thanks. after canary finishes, capture per-route p50/p95, kernel selection logs, and traceroute for any long tails.

ana: will collect traces and upload short CSV + perf flamegraphs to the bench bucket. tagging @eng-sre for proxy follow-up. :eyes:
